versions.changelog:
azure-bandwidth-optimizer 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides expert guidance to identify and reduce Azure bandwidth and egress costs.
- Analyzes exported cost/usage data and network topology (read-only; no credentials required).
- Delivers cost breakouts, heatmaps, and actionable optimization opportunities (CDN, Private Endpoints, etc.).
- Outputs include ROI calculations and Bicep/ARM snippets for key recommendations.
- Instruction-only: does not connect to Azure or run commands automatically.
